final_message:
Fixed. `is_leap_year` in `src/leap.py` only checked divisibility by 4, so 1900 came back as a leap year. It now also applies the century rule: not divisible by 100, unless divisible by 400.

All 6 tests pass now. Before the fix, `test_not_leap_1900` was the one failing.

You didn't say what "it" was, so I ran the tests and fixed the failure I found. If you meant something else, tell me what you saw.
